scripts.build: npm run vendor && vite build && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
scripts.app:sync: npm run build:app && npx cap sync android
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run test-data && playwright test
scripts.e2e:native: npm run test-data && playwright test -c playwright.native.config.ts
scripts.e2e:ride: npm run build && npm run test-data && playwright test -c playwright.ride.config.ts
scripts.e2e:live: npm run build && npm run test-data && playwright test -c playwright.live.config.ts
scripts.coverage:app: npm run build && npm run test-data && playwright test --config=playwright.coverage.config.ts --reporter=list
scripts.vendor: cd node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist && cp maplibre-gl.mjs maplibre-gl-shared.mjs maplibre-gl-worker.mjs maplibre-gl.css ../../../public
